title: Sources: the US and China are considering recurring talks on the security risks posed by AI models, with Scott Bessent leading the American side (Lingling Wei/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Lingling Wei / Wall Street Journal: Sources: the US and China are considering recurring talks on the security risks posed by AI models, with Scott Bessent leading the American side — Washington and Beijing recognize that powerful AI models could trigger crises neither side is prepared to manage
